name: weekday-highlight
label: Weekday Highlight
description: Sunday cells get a light-red fill (#FEE2E2) + red date number (#DC2626). Saturday neutral. All other days neutral. Light grey grid. Single visual cue, easy to read at a glance — theme says one thing: 'Sundays are different'.

_meta.rationale: 3-slot user-dot cycle: charcoal, slate, gray — all neutrals so the Sunday red stays the only loud visual cue. PRD §11.14 — user-first precedence; this cycle never applies to auto-loaded holidays.
